name: com.infinadeck.unityplugin
description: Translates Infinadeck omnidirectional treadmill motion into 1:1 locomotion for PCVR projects. Includes locomotion, reference objects, splash screen and demo tooling. Targets Unity 6 with URP and HDRP and the Input System.

samples.description: Example scene showing the [Infinadeck] prefab set up with reference objects and locomotion.
